However, in terms of Regulation 15(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 the requirement of filing of Corporate Governance Report as prescribed under Regulation 27 of said regulation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 is not applicable to our Company.
